typesense:trending.greeting:
*Currently, today was the day that new recruits were to be assigned a task onboard the XF-New leagues Submarine.*

Rear Admiral Grace: “Welcome to the seas new recruits. You all have been through university and camp, so I won’t be holding your hand - neither will anyone else. This mission is about going to the delta haydian, the most explored and safest haydian. You will listen to us, and in turn we’ll show you the ropes.” *She would clear her throat before speaking up again.* “The trip there will be 3 days, and I can’t have you lazing around. You all will have three tasks everyday to complete around the ship. If you don’t do them, you’re out. Period.”

*The Rear Admiral would then pick up a stack of papers from Miss Circle, organizing them to be the right order for specific branches.*

Miss Grace: “Now everybody, come get your tasks”

*After everyone has, she nods and walks off. Around the room, one could see everyone else on the deck looking at their task papers, or talking to one another, such as Engel talking with Claire and Abbie, or Oliver yapping about Alice, his "beloved" Leviathan girlfriend.*
